mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25% over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% over the prior 3 months indicate contracting consumer demand, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 0.5% and RSAFS declines > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >0.5% over prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100.5 indicates robust supply expansion, strengthening economic growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 100.5, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1200 thousand units signals weakening residential construction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls below 1200, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL (inflation) exceeding 0.3% and sustained FEDFUNDS rates above 5.0% over the prior 3 months signal monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% and FEDFUNDS > 5.0% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises >0.3% and FEDFUNDS >5.0% over prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% over the prior 3 months strengthens labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by >0.5% over prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rates exceeding 5.0% indicate restrictive monetary policy, increasing borrowing costs and dampening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
